notes.title: Descenders Next: the BRAKING NEWS Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/7a53d228f795f75b235dbba545a7658e3af31bd9.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

First of all, we want to thank you all so much for the love and support you've given Descenders Next since we launched into Early Access!

Of course, we've been monitoring and keeping an eye out on your feedback and thoughts so far, including bug reports, and we've been working hard in the background to start implementing changes! The most common bit of feedback we've received so far is to do with brakes, speed, and having a bit more control over it.

So, with that being said - we hear you, and we've introduced [b]BRAKING![/b] Now, you'll be able to slow your rider down at high speeds, and wherever you think you'd need to tactically use it! If you're a skilled Descenders player, you'll find braking will help in performing tricks better, but if you're a casual player, you'll find yourself bailing less! Braking can be activated with space if you're on keyboard, or left trigger on controller. This should hopefully address most concerns to do with riding at high speeds, and you should feel more control with your rider now! The update is out now on Steam, Xbox & Game Pass!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/85ba061b5c4a287cb2ffa93d0c854d2c29b9a77a.gif[/img]

We've also redone & adjusted the steepness of all the biomes to fit a little better with the new braking system. You can expect some trails to be a bit longer, and you'll find some extra props along some of the tracks (don't crash). We're also adjusting the tutorial & other UI elements to fit the new braking system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/f928c1a18866803bf9121276da60680f8fb32718.gif[/img]

Of course, we've got a bunch of bug fixes coming your way in this update too! Here's the full list of changes:

[b]Major features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Braking added to the game by pressing LT (controller)/Space (keyboard)
[*] Changes to the off-piste generation (less steep and longer trails)
[*] Acceleration tweaks to initial velocity
[/list]
[b]Minor features:[/b]
[list]
[*] World map lines show possible next levels
[*] Random area spawns (no longer spawn right on top of each other)
[*] Toggle UI during pause and bail state
[*] Show Time or Score during Race and SlopeStyle post-game
[*] Pause and Finish camera angles
[/list]
[b]Audio/SFX updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Several UI interactions added
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pagoda grind objective fix
[*] Kage mountain spawn issue
[*] Kita mountain shed wall glitch
[*] Objectives no longer disappear when bailing
[*] No longer count safe zone REP with session
[*] Prompt to perform Mute trick fix
[*] Menu no longer active in background during run
[*] Cloud sync fixes
[*] Fix for infinite skidding points on Mountainboard
[*] No longer negative health on big bails
[/list]
Once again, thank you all for the support so far! Be sure to keep sending in your thoughts and feedback - the best way to do this is through our [url=discord.gg/descenders]Discord![/url] 

If you haven't already, we would also love if you could [b]leave us a review[/b], we would love to hear your thoughts and how much you're enjoying the new update!

We'll see you out on the slopes!

notes.title: Thank you for an AMAZING Descenders Next Launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/698b71277a8237b4d25b0d703deb0e4786b3718b.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

It has been an incredible launch for Descenders Next! In just 24 hours, since we shadow dropped the game, we have had [b]over 100,000 of you[/b] jumping in and taking on the snowy peaks & dirt tracks! For context, it took the original Descenders 18 MONTHS to get those kind of numbers, so we are truly amazed at how many of you turned out to the launch, and we can't thank you enough!

If you're enjoying the game, we would love if you could [b]leave us a review[/b] on Steam, we can't explain how much it helps us out, and it gives us an idea on what everyone's thoughts are on Descenders Next!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/a5fb11339c6570c36991328f3f000f04a6b639f2.png[/img]

So, we've been receiving super useful feedback from you all while you've been playing, and we've already got a plan of things we're wanting to look at! Here is a quick run-down of a few things we've seen pop up often:
[list]
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] We know a lot of you are speed demons, but we hear that you'd like a bit more control over it too, so we're having a look at how we can make high speeds feel a bit easier to handle

[*] [b]Brakes:[/b] We've seen a few of you ask for some sort of brake mechanic to help with the high speeds, so this is something we're also taking a look at, which would also help with the speed topic from earlier

[*] [b]Multiplayer Game Modes:[/b] We hear you! We're looking at even more Multiplayer modes and opportunities to play with your friends, and more ways to smoothly progress through the map with your party
[/list]
We have so much more to come and so many cool things to add, be sure to check out the roadmap below to see some of the things we've got cooking! Be sure to join our [url=discord.gg/descenders]Discord[/url] too and chat with the community, and let us know your feedback there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/6eaedc141d4c35022e8900c2f0ed1fadc1e01ee8.png[/img]

We want to thank you again so much for the helpful feedback & love you've given Descenders Next in the last 24 hours alone! We can't wait to see what the future holds!

- RageSquid & No More Robots <3

notes.title: Refining the Ride: An Update on Descenders Next
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for all your amazing feedback![/h3]

It's incredible that 60,000 of you played our demo and helped us test Descenders Next. It's been incredible watching everyone play, and reading through your feedback has blown us away, so a massive thank you from all of us at RageSquid and No More Robots!

We're driven to make Descenders Next the best it can be, and reading through your feedback you made some great calls. We understand you feel the game needs some tweaks to make it feel like the ultimate Descenders experience, and we agree!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/98fb2c5776a268514a8fbc462abae5b6540f3074.gif[/img]

You hit on a few bits in your feedback that we want to iron out before we launch into early access. The team are already on it, adding in some highly requested features like key bindings, the first-person camera and the return of Enemy, Kinetic and Arboreal, but others will be a bigger undertaking.

This means getting Descenders Next ready for early access launch will take a little bit longer than we were anticipating, so we're going to give the game a little bit more time in the oven, and push the launch date back. We don't have a date for you just yet, as we're making sure that we've taken all your feedback on board and got our changes just right, but we're not going to keep you waiting too long.

We'll see you soon on the slopes with a new set of experiences -  a massive thank you for helping make the ultimate sports game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/0bdb2b65a3c7871d537a2a606461a6871961be5b.gif[/img]

[h3]RageSquid & No More Robots x[/h3]

notes.title: The Beta is over... What's Next?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/e93cb1f3ef6d541e01128878c29a36efa898dd20.png[/img]

We can't believe that 15,000 of you took to the slopes and the trails with us to try out Descenders Next, and your thoughts, feedback and gameplay videos totally blew us away!

The team have been hard at work while watching you play, listening to your feedback and planning what comes next as we look ahead to a little more testing and launch! 

[b]So let's talk about what's NEXT:[/b]
Here are some of the things we learned from the beta that we're putting into action RIGHT NOW, ready for you to get your hands on and play soon!

[h1]Animations, Physics and Ragdolls[/h1]
[quote=author] One of the points of feedback that was important to a lot of you was that the animations didn't feel quite right. The team are currently hard at work reworking these and adding in some fresh new movements to kick these up a gear in both sports! 

Alongside this, the physics are being worked on to keep the classic feel of Descenders, but make pulling off those big trick moments feel dangerous and exciting. It also means we're looking at those ragdolls. Did you want floppier bails? You've got them.  [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/50d51b77bb2bf1b4f6df71fdc7985947bdb96227.gif[/img]

[h1]A New Path for Snowboarding[/h1]
[quote=author] A problem we found while watching a lot of gameplay was that snowboarding and mountainboarding felt a little similar still, and snowboarding was missing the freedom that comes with hitting a brand new, open mountain.

To help bring in that feeling of freedom and give snowboarding its own identity, the trail on the ground is now unpronounced. You'll still get a feel for where the track is so you can follow the flow of the track down, or you're free to be more adventurous and seek out a different way down the mountain, finding your own obstacles and routes! Not only does this capture the real feel of snowboarding, but gives you more options to show off your team pride and ride the way you want!  [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/1b1693a6795958a5700fd01b7e35ce42d1404156.gif[/img]

[h1]First-Person View is on the Way[/h1]
[quote=author] First-person view is back baby! If you've missed the pure immersion of watching a tree rush up to you at high speed right before it cracks you in the skull, never fear - it's on its way back! We can't wait to see what crazy, flippy POV videos you come out with! [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/ec0ade77aa60527728d6c0a302e62631e1a7e630.gif[/img]

[h1]Classic Cannons and Procedural Generation[/h1]
[quote=author] While it was incredible watching you master each node in turn, we know you missed the original fun of procedural generation and finding new tracks with every run, so we're bringing that back! Each of the nodes not designated as something unique like a race or a park will now change every time you enter, bringing back the classic of mastering the biome!

There's another Descenders classic back at the edge of the maps too. We hope you'll have a good flight! [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/7c5f841445994b04f7c6ef80bf1b6bac0f3cadda.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved Steam Deck Performance[/h1]
[quote=author] Over the last year the Steam Deck has become a must-have piece of kit for so many of us, and so many folks wanted to grab theirs and head out and play on the go. We're committed to making sure Descenders Next runs as well as possible, no matter where you've picked to play. The Steam Deck version is getting an upgrade ready for some on-the-go boarding.  [/quote]

So when will you be able to jump back in? Well... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/ed9934b62e1695df22e5cbcb9bee2da31ee5ef2a.png[/img]

Did you notice that No More Robots is in the Xbox + IGN showcase at the end of the month?

[url=https://www.ign.com/articles/idxbox-showcase-to-kick-off-ign-fan-fest-2025]Check out the details here!
[/url]
We'll see you there! Until NEXT time!

notes.title: Descenders Next Test Sessions: Update 0.4.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136442/8b9c6c0fcce38f41278d9227bd42ac1e281f3a85.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Thank you all so much for all the feedback given while playing the Descenders Next Test Sessions! We've been hard at work addressing a bunch of feedback, and are happy to release the 0.4.9 patch!

[b]If you haven't played yet, where've you been?! You can still grab yourself a key for the Descenders Next Test Sessions by [url=https://gleam.io/0lfP8/play-the-descenders-next-test-sessions-now]clicking here![/url]
[/b]
A quick little heads-up, due to many internal changes we'll have to wipe the player data, which means you can start the beta from the beginning again, how awesome is that!

Another heads-up regarding replays. Replays in the off-piste won't work anymore, due to many changes in the procedural generation. Also because we've done some physics changes, there might be other things broken with old replays. Sorry about that!

Anyway, here's the changelog:

[b]Changelog 0.4.9
[/b]
[b]Features:
[/b][list]
[*] Bigger world map (more nodes between safe zones)
[*] Tweaks to off-piste trails (both Snowy Peaks and Grassy Highlands)
[*] Filter for event notifications
[*] Level name now shown in pause menu
[*] Settings menu now loops
[*] Objectives now reset when doing a full respawn in off-piste
[*] Can only respawn in off-piste at low velocity and on ground
[/list]
[b]Physics changes:
[/b][list]
[*] Lowered A to accelerate initial velocity
[*] Fix for 'body sliding' / landing your board in an almost 90 degree angle
[*] Sideways landing now bails on higher velocities and impacts
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:
[/b][list]
[*] Save replay screen is now compatible with Ultrawide monitors
[*] Press space to RIDE removed
[*] Fixed an issue where respawn markers were not being removed properly
[*] Pressing back on World Map now goes to Biome Select
[*] Fixed an issue where the backward button would initiate the replay pop up 
[*] Fixed an issue where you'd get stuck before a run by hitting replay on accident
[*] Airtime objective is now a progress bar instead of 0/1
[*] Objective 70 km/h now set to mph when changing metric units
[*] Improvements made to the penalty timer
[*] Fixed an issue relating to grabbing collectibles while bailing
[*] Spins and tricks now count double when going for objects, for example: 720 now counts as two 360's for an objective
[*] Fixed an issue where ambient sound would still play when going into menu from base camp
[*] Fixed an issue with markers respawning opposite way
[*] Replays are now saved by pressing Y on the bail screen, consistent with Post Game screen
[*] Fixed an issue where the timer could be paused during a race
[*] Hard landings are now fixed in replays
[*] Fixes for cloud save not working in some cases
[/list]
We want to thank you all again for your valuable feedback while playing Descenders Next! We love to see how much you're all enjoying it, and can't wait to make the game even better! Keep sending over your feedback, cool moments and bug reports in the meantime, either in our [url=discord.gg/descenders]Discord[/url] or [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScBnovfBk3NSnHerWLciLRk7YutjcQr42O0127H7aMGuZ2g4w/viewform]feedback form[/url], and we'll see you in-game!

- RageSquid & No More Robots

notes.title: Maps, Medals & More in Descenders Next!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're back with another video in our series, where we answer your questions about Descenders Next, while giving you more sneak peeks into the game!

This time, we're telling you a little more about the maps in Descenders, medals you can earn while playing, and what you can expect to find along the way!

The world in Descenders Next is even bigger than Descenders, with more variety in tracks, and loads of rewarding ways to earn DesCents through tricks & medals! The better the medal, the higher the rewards! The more DesCents you have, the more fancy gear you can buy at shops dotted around the world!
